projects.title: Temperature Prediction using Different ML and DL Algorithms
description: Developed a temperature prediction system using multiple machine learning and deep learning algorithms.
Implemented various regression models like Linear Regression, Random Forest, and Neural Networks to predict temperature.
projects.tools: Python, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, Keras, Pandas, Numpy

projects.title: Amount of Sale Prediction in a Super Shop named Amana
description: Developed a predictive model to forecast sales in a super shop using historical data.
Used time series analysis and models like ARIMA, Random Forest, and Gradient Boosting for predictions.

projects.title: Emotion Detection from Audio Data Using Transfer Learning
description: Implemented a transfer learning model to detect emotions from audio data.
Leveraged pre-trained models like VGGish and fine-tuned them on emotion-labeled audio clips.
projects.tools: Python, TensorFlow, Keras, Librosa, Transfer Learning Models

projects.title: Authorship Attribution using Statistical technique Markov model
description: Developed a statistical model for authorship attribution based on writing style.
Used Markov Model to analyze trends in writing style such as sentence length, punctuation usage.

projects.title: Filtering IMDb Movie Review System with BERT Model
description: Built a movie review filtering system using BERT-based transformer models.
Classified reviews into 4 categories: excellent, good, average, bad.
Compared BERT with traditional models like RFC, LR, XGBoost.
projects.tools: Python, Hugging Face Transformers, BERT, Scikit-learn

projects.title: Sarcasm Detection in Bengali Language using Deep Learning
description: Applied custom BERT model with bi-LSTM and self-supervised learning (MLM) to detect sarcasm in Bangla.
Achieved 82% accuracy, highest among existing studies.
projects.tools: Python, Hugging Face Transformers, BERT, Scikit-learn, LSTM

projects.title: Saint Common Detection using Transfer Learning
description: Used Bangla-Blend Dataset with custom BERT models and self-supervised learning (MLM).
Achieved 97% accuracy, a significant achievement in NLP.
projects.tools: Python, Hugging Face Transformers, BERT, Scikit-learn, LSTM

projects.title: IPA transcription in Bengali Language
description: Trained a seq-to-seq model to translate Bangla Text to IPA.
Built a custom function to handle corner cases for improved performance.

projects.title: Local Dialect Translation using Machine Learning
description: Trained BanglaT5 model on ONUBAD dataset for regional dialect to standard Bangla translation.
Achieved a WER of 0.09.

projects.title: Erosion-Deposition Detection using ML Models
description: Led a project under Lab of Oitik with two Civil Engineering students.
Developed models for detecting erosion and deposition patterns.
Boosting algorithms achieved R² scores of 0.95 (erosion) and 0.97 (deposition).
projects.tools: Python, Scikit-learn, Random Forest, Boosting Algorithms
